sn22.101:1.2: jānato’haṃ bhikkhave, passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi. no ajānato no apassato.
sn22.101:1.3: kiñca bhikkhave, jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti:
sn22.101:1.4: iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo.
sn22.101:1.8: iti viññāṇaṃ. iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamoti.
sn22.101:1.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave, jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.101:2.1: bhāvanānuyogamananuyuttassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viharato kiñcā’pi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
sn22.101:2.2: “aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā”ti, atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:2.6: abhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ, abhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ, abhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ, abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ, abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ, abhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ, abhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
sn22.101:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni na sammā paribhāvitāni.
sn22.101:3.3: kiñcā’pi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
sn22.101:3.4: “aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyu”nti.
sn22.101:3.5: atha kho abhabbā’va te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
sn22.101:3.7: tathā hi pana bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.8: tāni kukkuṭiyā na sammā adhisayitāni na sammā pariseditāni na sammā paribhāvitāni.
sn22.101:3.9: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanānuyogamananuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
sn22.101:3.10: “aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti, atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:3.14: abhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ, abhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ, abhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ, abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ, abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ, abhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ, abhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
sn22.101:4.1: bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya,
sn22.101:4.2: ‘aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti, atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:4.6: bhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ, bhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ, bhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ, bhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ, bhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ, bhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ, bhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
sn22.101:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:5.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni, sammā pariseditāni, sammā paribhāvitāni.
sn22.101:5.3: kiñcā’pi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
sn22.101:5.4: “aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyayyu”nti.
sn22.101:5.5: atha kho bhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
sn22.101:5.7: tathā hi pana bhikkhave, kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:5.8: tānassu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā parisedhitāni sammā paribhāvitāni.
sn22.101:5.9: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcā’pi na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
sn22.101:5.10: “aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyā”ti, atha khvassa anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:5.14: bhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ, bhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ, bhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ, bhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ, bhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ, bhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
sn22.101:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, palagaṇḍassa vā palagaṇḍantevāsissavā vā vāsijaṭe dissante vā aṅgulipadāni dissanti aṅguṭṭhapadā,
sn22.101:6.2: no ca khvassa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti;
sn22.101:6.3: “ettakaṃ vata me ajja vāsijaṭaṃ khīṇaṃ ettakaṃ hiyyo, ettakaṃ pare”ti.
sn22.101:6.4: atha khvassa khīṇe khīṇaṃtveva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.101:6.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti:
sn22.101:6.6: “ettakaṃ vata me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇaṃ, ettakaṃ hiyyo, ettakaṃ pare”ti. atha khvassa khīṇe khīṇaṃtveva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.101:6.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya chammāsāni udake pariyādāya hemantikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni bandhanāni. tāni pāvussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhāni appakasirene paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti.
sn22.101:6.8: evameva kho bhikkhave, bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato appakasireneva saññojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavantīti.
